reason: My admin already types the receipts into Excel. Yes, it's always behind, but it costs me nothing extra, and $19 a month is real money when I take home about $3,000. I might throw the free 40 at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay for it this month.
objection: I already pay someone to do this, and there are free tools like Zoho or KasKecil, or a bot my nephew could build. Why pay a monthly fee for something my admin does anyway, and will it really read messy handwritten nota from my suppliers?
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial on my old chat history caught duplicates or missing money my admin missed, enough to cover a year of the fee, I would pay.
